TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is an SECP-incorporated Pakistani company established in 2012, with operations in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore and Karachi, and a 250-person team including six PMP-certified project managers and four PE-registered engineers. [CO-PROFILE] We are FBR-registered with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status and can arrange bid security as a CDR/bank guarantee from scheduled banks within our banking facility. [CO-PROFILE] Our delivery is governed by ISO 9001 quality management and ISO 27001 information security practices, aligned to the RFP’s mandatory compliance requirements. [CO-PROFILE]

For State Life Insurance Corporation of Pakistan, we propose a secure, cloud-deployed corporate website and customer self-service portal with authenticated, role-based access, auditability, REST API integration to the existing core policy system, payment gateway integration, and a one-year warranty support model with defined response times. Our capability to deliver security-sensitive, transaction-grade digital services is evidenced by multiple large-scale mobile banking deployments (PKR 41M–121M) and cybersecurity implementations (PKR 15M–178M), including ISO 27001-aligned engagements. [CAP-035] [CAP-023] [CAP-001] [CAP-049] We also bring proven cloud delivery experience from federal government cloud infrastructure programs, supporting reliable deployment into client cloud environments. [CAP-012] [CAP-048]

We will deliver end-to-end UX/UI, responsive front-end, and a content-managed corporate website; however, our current library does not yet evidence at least three explicitly “web/software development” projects valued at PKR 5M+ in the last five years as stated in the mandatory criterion. We will address this gap by proposing verifiable, relevant software development references from our LMS/ERP portfolio and, if required by State Life, by adding a specialist web-portal delivery partner to strengthen compliance. [CAP-010] [CAP-046] [CAP-050]
